t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The player was not sure how the different coulors of the gnomes impacts the cooulred baskets. They played around a bit and found that the mushroom count kept on changing. They said to try playing around a bit with it and they thought perhaps complimentary colours might be the key to figuring it out.

vb_textbox.text: For the most part the game is about figuring out when the colour scheme is supposed to match the backgorund or not. Most of the game the colours that were in contrast to the forest ie red, purple were giving more points than the one that matched the forest ie green, yellow, blue. Sometimes it would switch in the middle of the round but for the most part the colours more in contrast to the forest were the ones that gave more mushrooms
